items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: The only person that was, I think Big Bob Miles was the only person that was playing in the band with me.

ctx.x: You must have had a different band by then. Oh yeah. Let me see. The only person that was, I think Big Bob Miles was the only person that was playing in the band with me. That was with me when I started. I think. I don't know. No Big Bob Miles wasn't in the band either. Now Batman played with me.
